subject: Post-call recap + draft plan — checking timing for EOQ decision
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + draft MAP from today's call

Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from my side and a one-page mutual action plan attached.

Summary of today's discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and 95th‑percentile latency for their fraud‑scoring pipeline while maintaining detection quality.
- Target workload: ~120k requests/day, mostly 512‑token average payloads.
- Security: must live inside their VPC; SOC2 evidence and audit logs required.
- Timeline: preferring a Q1 pilot, then production rollout in Q2 if procurement clears.

Next steps (pending your confirmation):
1) Review the attached MAP (NB-MAP-draft-v1.pdf) and confirm priorities/owners.
2) I can loop in our solutions engineer for a short technical sync next week (30 min).
3) If procurement wants an initial SOW stub, I attached a template we can tailor.

Can you confirm who on your side would own procurement sign‑off and what your expected approval window looks like? If this is still Q1 priority, we can priority‑shift resources on our side.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments: NB-MAP-draft-v1.pdf (1 page), SOW-template.docx (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick recap + draft MAP from today's call

Soojin — saw the MAP, looks solid. Alex is the right contact. If we don't hear back by next week, offer a 60‑day pilot credit to unstick procurement. Keep me looped and I can help escalate.

— Ben
Director, Sales

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — MAP + procurement path

Alex — quick nudge on the MAP I shared last week (attached again). Did you have a chance to review with your procurement or security teams?

Key questions that will determine timing:
- Is procurement the blocker or is there a technical gating item?
- Do you expect approval to land this quarter (EOQ week of Mar 20) or should we plan for Q2?

We want to avoid building drift on resource allocation — if this needs to slide, that's totally fine, just let us know and we'll adjust. If procurement needs a tailored SOW or SOC2 artifacts, we can move those in parallel.

Re-attached: NB-MAP-draft-v1.pdf, SOW-template.docx

Thanks for the quick flag — even a one‑line update helps.

Best,
--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: move-to-close options

If we don't get a response by EOD Thu (Mar 16), offer: 60‑day pilot with a reduced token rate + a capped SLA for the pilot period. Mark as an internal concession — do not promise more than one scope change without legal/finance signoff.

I'll be ready to jump on a call with procurement if we get looped in.

— Ben
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, procurement@northbridgebank.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ check — final week push (quick yes/no)

Alex — last touch this week as we're entering North America's EOQ. Short ask: are you still prioritizing this before Mar 24? Two quick options so we can align our capacity: 

A) Yes — procurement clears in time: we schedule a 30‑day pilot starting Mar 27; I'll draft a short SOW and loop legal.
B) Delay — push to Q2: we park the MAP and re‑engage after your budget cycle.

If it's helpful, per Ben's note we can offer a 60‑day pilot credit to accelerate procurement approval (internal approval required on our side).

Would appreciate a one‑line update by EOD Fri (Mar 16) so I can set expectations with the SE team.

Thanks —
--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0132
